about: What a laptop needs to run Shyft, and exactly which model files Shyft was measured with. The download and the screens read their numbers from this file. Change a number here first, never in a screen or a script.
decision: D27, ruled by Sphinx on 2026-11-25. Evidence: build-log-6.md.

shape.summary: Two models. The larger one guards, the smaller one names.

gate.job: Looks at every screenshot first and locks what is sensitive.

namer.job: Names and sorts what Zippy cleared. Never sees a locked screenshot.

files_rule: After any download, compare the id that 'ollama list' shows with the id above. A different id is a different build that was never measured: say so to the person, do not run quietly. Names can be re-pointed; ids cannot. On a Mac the short names give other files (17 GB, different answers), so always pull the long names.

server.note: Use 127.0.0.1, never localhost (on Windows localhost adds 2 seconds to every call).

floor.who_this_is_for: Laptops with 16 GB of memory or more: every Copilot+ PC and every MacBook Air sold new since October 30, 2024. It leaves out 8 GB laptops, including base MacBook Airs bought before that date.
floor.below_the_floor: Not promised. Let the person try, and record what happens. The candidate for smaller laptops is one model for both jobs (gemma4:e2b): same catches, but it locks 25 to 31% of ordinary screenshots and names 67 to 72%.

pace.what: Seconds per screenshot, measured with these two models.

minimum_no_graphics_card.measured_on: Legion, processor only (24-core i9), real set

apple_chip.measured_on: M1 Pro, 32 GB, made-up set, with the Mac's own files (not the files above)

ideal_graphics_card.measured_on: Legion, RTX 4090 Laptop GPU, real set

pace.plain_words: Daily screenshots take minutes on any of these. A backlog of thousands takes an evening with a graphics card and several nights without one.

bar.rule: Zippy should catch at least 80% of sensitive screenshots and lock no more than 10% of ordinary ones, on both test sets. The bar does not move.
bar.status: Ships below the bar on real screenshots, on the record: one file short each way.
bar.cost_of_a_miss: All 3 missed real screenshots would get a file name that gives the private thing away.
bar.what_may_be_said: On 12 real sensitive screenshots Zippy caught 9; on 23 made-up ones, 23. Never 'catches everything'.
bar.next_run: A fresh 50 real screenshots, drawn at random and labelled blind before any model sees them. Rule written first.

unverified: No 8 GB or 16 GB laptop has run Shyft. The 16 GB floor is inferred from memory measured on a 32 GB laptop (the gate model holds about 6.5 GiB while it works).
No Mac has run the two files above. Expected: the same ids, 11.2 GB. One run on a Mac settles it: both ids match, and Zippy gives the same answer on all 91 made-up screenshots.
The only processor-only pace comes from a 24-core chip. An ordinary laptop will be slower by an unmeasured amount.
Whether Ollama swaps the two models cleanly on a 16 GB laptop. If not, OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 forces one at a time.
revisit_if: Fewer than 3 of the first 5 outside testers finish a full run on their own laptop by 2026-12-01. Then the floor shuts out people we can reach, and the one-model option for smaller laptops moves from a lead to the next build.
